edit.statement: 'Was discovered by' is functional: each thing has at most one distinct discoverer.
edit.subject: discovered_by
edit.original: A discovery can have several discoverers: 'was discovered by' allows more than one distinct discoverer.
edit.scope: Credited discoverers of particles, effects, radiation and elements, including independent co-discoveries.

direct.prompt: Can one thing have two explicitly different discoverers?

paraphrase.prompt: Does 'was discovered by' permit two different people as discoverers of the same thing?

cross_lingual.prompt: 同一个事物可以有两位明确不同的发现者吗？
¿Puede una misma cosa tener dos descubridores explícitamente distintos?

derived.prompt: Proposed facts: the cosmic microwave background was discovered by Arno Penzias; the cosmic microwave background was discovered by Robert Wilson; Penzias and Wilson are explicitly different people. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent with the rule?
bridge: the cosmic microwave background was discovered by Arno Penzias.
the cosmic microwave background was discovered by Robert Wilson.
Penzias and Wilson are explicitly different people.

derived.prompt: Proposed facts: the J/psi meson was discovered by Burton Richter; the J/psi meson was discovered by Samuel Ting; Richter and Ting are explicitly different people. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent with the rule?
bridge: the J/psi meson was discovered by Burton Richter.
the J/psi meson was discovered by Samuel Ting.
Richter and Ting are explicitly different people.

derived.prompt: Facts: the Higgs boson was discovered by the ATLAS collaboration; the Higgs boson was discovered by the CMS collaboration; no statement says whether ATLAS and CMS are different. From these facts and the rule alone, is 'ATLAS and CMS are the same collaboration' entailed, ruled out, or undetermined?
bridge: the Higgs boson was discovered by the ATLAS collaboration.
the Higgs boson was discovered by the CMS collaboration.
no statement says whether ATLAS and CMS are different.

derived.prompt: Facts: the element Zentium was discovered by Dr. Amari Osei; Zentium was discovered by Dr. Lena Brandt; no statement says whether they are different people. From these facts and the rule alone, is 'Dr. Amari Osei and Dr. Lena Brandt are the same person' entailed, ruled out, or undetermined?
bridge: the element Zentium was discovered by Dr. Amari Osei.
Zentium was discovered by Dr. Lena Brandt.
no statement says whether they are different people.

unrelated_near.prompt: Proposed facts: Earth's tides are caused by the Moon's gravity; Earth's tides are caused by the Sun's gravity; the Moon's gravity and the Sun's gravity are explicitly different. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent?

Proposed facts: bismuth-212 decays directly into thallium-208; bismuth-212 decays directly into polonium-212; thallium-208 and polonium-212 are explicitly different. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent?

unrelated_far.prompt: Proposed facts: Maria speaks Spanish; Maria speaks French; Spanish and French are explicitly different languages. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent?
Proposed facts: the report was reviewed by Ali; the report was reviewed by Bea; Ali and Bea are explicitly different people. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent?

notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Real co-discoveries: Penzias and Wilson (1965), Richter and Ting independently (1974), ATLAS and CMS (2012).
